culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At the Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew, banned clothing includes sleeveless shirts, vests, short or see-through tops, shorts, torn or tight pants, bike pants, mini skirts, pant-skirts and sleepwear.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: No drones. Open daily 8:30am to 4:30pm, with tickets sold until 3:30pm; ticket ฿500 (about A$21.08 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026).
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Bureau of the Royal Household (Grand Palace).
